messages.content: You are a teaching assistant. A student's C program gave a wrong result on one input. In at most 2 sentences explain WHY the code fails on this input, citing line numbers; then give a 1-sentence fix hint. Do not write code. Reply as JSON with keys explanation and fix_hint.

data.explanation: The code fails because it does not handle an array with all negative numbers correctly. On line 10, `here` is incremented by `nums[i]`, which is a large negative number, and it is never reset to a positive value, leading to the wrong result.
data.fix_hint: Initialize `here` to a value greater than any possible element in the array to ensure it can start positive.
